title: (RHBA-2025:21678) s390utils bug fix and enhancement update
portal_summary: An update for s390utils is now available for Red Hat Enterprise Linux 9.0 Update Services for SAP Solutions.
portal_synopsis: s390utils bug fix and enhancement update
portal_product_filter: Red Hat Enterprise Linux|Red Hat Enterprise Linux for IBM z Systems - 4 years of updates|9.0|s390x
portal_solution:
For details on how to apply this update, which includes the changes described in this advisory, refer to:

https://access.redhat.com/articles/11258
portal_description:
The s390utils packages contain a set of user-space utilities that should be used together with the zSeries (s390) Linux kernel and device drivers.

Bug Fix(es) and Enhancement(s):

* Long kernel command line parameters for zipl in RHEL 9.0.z (JIRA:RHEL-105492)
